name: GS Global Corp
summary: GS Global Corp. engages in the export, logistics, import and trade of steel and natural resources. It operates through the Industrial Materials and Import Distribution Business divisions. The Industrial Materials division provides steel, petroleum, and chemical products, cement, coal, machine plants, and other materials import and export. The Import Distribution division offers engine and biomass imports, imported automobiles pre-delivery inspection service, and general logistics services. The company was founded on July 31, 1954 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
